info.text:
In 2023, Netflix started charging password sharers and added 29.5 million paid members that year.
In early 2023 Netflix estimated its accounts were shared with 100M+ extra households. In May 2023, US sharers got a choice: their own plan or a $7.99/month extra member slot.
Paid memberships rose from 230.75M (end of 2022) to 301.63M (end of 2024), and yearly revenue grew from $31.6B in 2022 to $45.2B in 2025. Price increases and the ad tier also contributed.
Our math: at the May 2023 US price, one $7.99 extra member = $95.88 a year (that price has since gone up).
Sources: Netflix shareholder letters (Q2 2023, Q4 2023, Q4 2024, Q4 2025) and 10-K; TechCrunch; CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
